implementationNotes: Release freeze (OPAG-65) acknowledged: no quest-cli release from now until this campaign's wave 3. 0.4.0 (QCLI-241) was the last incremental release. Fixes land on dev behind their tests and wait for the stacked wave-3 release; exception only for a security fix or a fleet-blocking defect, by the orchestrator's own ruling recorded on OPAG-65. Starting wave 0 now.

Wave 0 complete. QCLI-200, QCLI-201, QCLI-97 archived as superseded (not paused -- all three were "To Do", never started, so quest task pause was structurally inapplicable by design; used the campaign's own stated alternative instead, confirmed correct by the orchestrator). QCLI-156 decided: already resolved and shipped by QCLI-157 before this campaign started, verified live in current source plus an existing regression test; no code change needed, task moved to Done. QCLI-216 repaired: removed QCLI-208's two phantom acceptance criteria (literal "5", a confirmed Backlog.md CLI defect), QCLI-208 stayed Done throughout, task moved to Done.

User ruling recorded on OPAG-65/the campaign Story (2026-09-07): wave 3's stacked release is quest 0.5.0, synced with lore 0.5.0 -- from that release on, the two CLIs move in lockstep at every stacked release, one number naming the pair. This is a synced minor, not a semantic one (pre-1.0 allowed); the CHANGELOG for 0.5.0 should say the jump from 0.4.x is the version sync, not a breaking change, so consumers don't go looking for one that isn't there. No action before wave 3.
